name: @cardbey/display-webos
description: Cardbey Display LG webOS shell (thin host for @cardbey/display-runtime)

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && vite build && node scripts/copy-webos-assets.mjs && node scripts/validate-dist.mjs
scripts.package:minimal: pnpm run prebuild && tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && vite build && node scripts/copy-webos-assets.mjs && node scripts/validate-dist.mjs && node scripts/package-ipk.mjs
